$Comment: Wood of every kind, logs, planks, beams and trim: the blocks whose item is tagged Type Wood, but no torch (a torch is the Light family's, so one placement never reads both families' thrift). BuildThrift_Wood spares placing them. A block joins any family by naming it in its own item Tags under ZigBlockFamily, so another mod opts its blocks in from its own files. Retune or switch it off by id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/block-families.json.
